faqs.q: Is there a free Zapier alternative?
faqs.a: Yes. Make has a free plan with 1,000 credits a month, Activepieces is free for up to 5 users, and 50agents is free to start.

faqs.q: Which Zapier alternative connects the most apps?
faqs.a: Make lists 3,500+ apps and n8n lists 2,829 integrations. 50agents works with 2,300+ apps through viaSocket. Zapier itself connects 10,541+.

faqs.q: Can I import my Zaps into another tool?
faqs.a: Not directly. Plan to rebuild each Zap in the new tool, starting with the one that runs most often.
